title: pyrola picta subsp. dentata
intro: Pyrola picta subsp. dentata, commonly known as Alpine Wintergreen, is a species of flowering plant in the heath family, Ericaceae. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its ability to aid in digestion, reduce inflammation, and act as a natural expectorant. The therapeutic actions of Pyrola picta subsp. dentata include its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents, such as methyl salicylate and salicin. However, it's worth noting that more research is needed to confirm the exact bioactive constituents of this plant.
